5ad182e2-9e18-45da-b400-3a7d0735217b.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 {g|Encyclopedia:Round}round{/g}, the targeted area's {g|Encyclopedia:Bonus}bonuses{/g} are tripled. All other tactical areas are discharged and cannot be used this {g|Encyclopedia:Turn}turn{/g}, but can be designated again next round. {g|f:27812417ab8047519e401ed4a58790fd}Strategic Focus{/g} stacks: -+5: The Grand Strategist gains stacks after using this ability.

7f06e488-dcb4-4d97-9a2a-af4291a58a0d.Text: Whenever the wearer uses {g|f:be619d39ec424c9daec488acf25ae86b}Combat Locus Stratagem{/g}, the benefits of the targeted zone are multiplied sixfold instead of being tripled.

5a607afb-c716-4e07-9195-70c7793a893e.Text: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all enemies in that area suffer +100% critical damage and are forced to re-roll successful {g|Encyclopedia:DodgeGlossary}dodge{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:Parry}parry{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g} against all attacks. Any enemies that suffer damage and are left with less than {uip|MinimumWounds|ab86bcee2036424c90dd12c2ad3fab39} {g|Encyclopedia:HitPoints}wounds{/g} immediately die. If an enemy is killed, another attack can be made this turn by the attacker and they will gain +4 MP. {g|f:27812417ab8047519e401ed4a58790fd}Strategic Focus{/g} stacks: -+7: Per kill.

73652c02-a15b-4589-baa2-7b50f55106e7.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all allies in that area gain +{uip|CoverBonus|0e89f6eda1ae4960aeebfed0737289a3}% {g|Encyclopedia:DetailsOfTheCoverGlossary}cover efficiency{/g} and re-roll all failed {g|Encyclopedia:Characteristic}characteristic{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:Test}tests{/g}. Additionally, cover in the area does not suffer any damage. Each unit in the area will recover +(1 + Level/10) wounds at the start and end of their turns. {g|f:27812417ab8047519e401ed4a58790fd}Strategic Focus{/g}: -+1: At the start and end of turns (if inside of the zone). -+2: After using a non-attacking ability.

62b80a48-78ea-4116-8b1c-8c45b8534730.Text: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, allies in that area gain +{uip|BonusArmour|111f6e8111ae4d30a9d5d6d06027281d}% {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerArmourGlossary}armour{/g}, cannot be overpenetrated, gain immunity to the {g|Encyclopedia:ProneEffect}prone{/g} effect, and gain +{uip|BonusDeflection|111f6e8111ae4d30a9d5d6d06027281d} {g|Encyclopedia:Deflection}deflection{/g} against area attacks. Additionally, they do not suffer {g|Encyclopedia:Injury}injuries{/g} for receiving damage. At the start and end of each turn they will gain +(10 + {uip|BonusArmour|111f6e8111ae4d30a9d5d6d06027281d}) temporary wounds. {g|f:27812417ab8047519e401ed4a58790fd}Strategic Focus{/g} stacks: -+1: After being attacked by an enemy, regardless if they hit or miss. +1: After landing a hit in melee. -+2: At the start and end of turn (if inside of the zone).

0c3d44f8-a342-4683-a7c0-b46cc99aefaf.Text: The {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist{/g} chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all allies within the range of {uip|Range|7005fbf810a64264893cd18fc0187b39} cells gain the {g|Encyclopedia:Ability}ability{/g} to move to that area. This movement does not provoke {g|Encyclopedia:AttackOfOpportunityFullGlossary}attacks of opportunity{/g} and does not spend {g|Encyclopedia:MovementPoints}MP{/g}. The next attack made during this round will not cost MP. {g|f:27812417ab8047519e401ed4a58790fd}Strategic Focus{/g} stacks: -+3: After activation of the movement ability.

4c202309-6c31-4e52-ab02-6e3dff6543f4.Text: The Grand Strategist chooses one of the {g|f:e4e45f74936c4740b7bc03013f6991ba}Combat Tactics{/g} areas. For 1 round, all attacks by allies in that area do +50% more damage and inflict the {g|f:27c28c48cd154096afcace5ac4ec66b6}overwhelmed{/g} effect on any enemy that fails a Willpower {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} and the {g|f:866cb491aeda45869e40a9165447a7cc}staggered{/g} effect to any enemy that fails a Toughness {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance test{/g} for 1 round. {g|f:27812417ab8047519e401ed4a58790fd}Strategic Focus{/g} stacks: -+1: After landing a hit. -+2: After using an attacking ability.

131c5c41-6b16-4b79-96ff-ace28919e281.Text: This unit has executed on one or more of the {g|Encyclopedia:CareerStrategistGlossary}Grand Strategist's{/g} stratagems. Gain +1 to all characteristics and +2% damage per stack.

9d18b557-fb33-42c3-8599-65a75cc9fcbb.Text: {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerWillpower}Willpower{/g} and {g|Encyclopedia:WarhammerToughness}Toughness{/g} {g|Encyclopedia:ResistanceTest}resistance tests{/g} forced by {g|f:807137df735b46858a3e562b49bb89b1}Overwhelming Stratagem{/g} are made with a −{uip|ResistancePenalty|2758369cb14a43cdb72df3e7d1aad9cb} {g|Encyclopedia:Penalty}penalty{/g}.
